# Fig 5C (top)

Fraction of reconstructed ER surface assigned to mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCS).

**Source data**  
`Fig 5C.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX
- `Mito` — Mitochondrial reconstruction ID
- `ER_surf_um2` — Endoplasmic reticulum surface area (µm²)
- `ERMCS_surf_um2` — Mitochondria–ER contact area (µm²)

## Data

The contact fraction is ERMCS surface area divided by total ER surface area.

```{r fig-5c-top-data}
condition_order <- c("Control", "TTX")
spacing_map <- c("Control" = 1, "TTX" = 2.2)

Density <- read_csv("./Fig 5C.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% condition_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_order),
    Date = factor(trimws(as.character(Date))),
    across(c(ERMCS_surf_um2, ER_surf_um2), as.numeric),
    MERCS_per_ER = ERMCS_surf_um2 / ER_surf_um2,
    x_pos = unname(spacing_map[as.character(Condition)]),
    color_key = paste(Condition, Date, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(MERCS_per_ER), ER_surf_um2 > 0)

if (nrow(Density) == 0) stop("No valid MERCS/ER measurements remain.")

Density %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

## Summary

```{r fig-5c-top-summary}
summary_table <- Density %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_Mitochondria = n(),
    n_Experiment_Dates = n_distinct(Date),
    `Mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(MERCS_per_ER), sd(MERCS_per_ER) / sqrt(n())),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_table
```

## Statistics

Two-way ANOVA with condition, experiment date, and their interaction (Type I sums of squares).

```{r fig-5c-top-statistics}
fit_aov <- aov(MERCS_per_ER ~ Condition * Date, data = Density)
anova_table <- anova(fit_aov)
condition_p <- as.numeric(anova_table["Condition", "Pr(>F)"])
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", p))

group_means <- Density %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(MERCS_per_ER), SE = sd(MERCS_per_ER) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

stats_table <- tibble(
  Test = "Two-way ANOVA",
  Comparison = "Control vs TTX",
  `Control mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", group_means$mean[1], group_means$SE[1]),
  `TTX mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", group_means$mean[2], group_means$SE[2]),
  `Condition p` = format_p(condition_p)
)

stats_table
```

## Plot

```{r fig-5c-top-plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=14, fig.retina=1, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
set.seed(20261109)
p_to_stars <- function(p) case_when(
  p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**",
  p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
)

test_results <- tibble(
  group1_x = spacing_map["Control"],
  group2_x = spacing_map["TTX"],
  y_position = 0.5,
  stars = p_to_stars(condition_p)
) %>%
  filter(stars != "ns")

date_levels <- levels(Density$Date)

date_colors <- c(
  setNames(rep(c("#1A1A1A", "#4D4D4D", "#6F7C80"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("Control", date_levels, sep = "_")),
  setNames(rep(c("#003B5C", "#2596D1", "#A6D9F5"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("TTX", date_levels, sep = "_"))
)

fig5c_top_plot <- ggplot(Density, aes(x_pos, MERCS_per_ER, color = color_key)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(cex = 6, priority = "random", size = 20,
                            alpha = 1, corral = "random") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = x_pos), fill = NA, width = 1, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = x_pos), fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 15, size = 30, color = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = test_results,
               aes(x = group1_x, xend = group2_x, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = test_results,
            aes(x = (group1_x + group2_x) / 2, y = y_position + 0.01, label = stars),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 30, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unname(spacing_map),
                     labels = c("control", "homeostatic\nplasticity")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = date_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(oob = scales::oob_keep, breaks = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5),
                     limits = c(0, 0.55), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "MERCS /\ntotal ER area") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

fig5c_top_plot
```

```{r fig-5c-top-save, include=FALSE}
dir.create("./Graphs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

output_file <- "./Graphs/Fig 5C (top).png"

ggsave(output_file, fig5c_top_plot, width = 18, height = 14, units = "in", dpi = 300)

tibble(Figure = "Fig 5C (top)", File = output_file)
```

# Fig 5D

Estimated number of ribosomes proximal to reconstructed juxtaspinal mitochondrial regions.

**Source data**  
`Fig 5D, E.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX
- `Mito` — Mitochondrial reconstruction ID
- `n_ribosomes` — Estimated ribosome count within 50 nm of the outer mitochondrial membrane

## Data

```{r fig-5d-data}
condition_order <- c("Control", "TTX")
spacing_map <- c("Control" = 1, "TTX" = 2.2)

Density <- read_csv("./Fig 5D, E.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% condition_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_order),
    Date = factor(trimws(as.character(Date))),
    n_ribosomes = as.numeric(n_ribosomes),
    x_pos = unname(spacing_map[as.character(Condition)]),
    color_key = paste(Condition, Date, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(n_ribosomes))

if (nrow(Density) == 0) stop("No valid ribosome measurements remain.")

Density %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

  summarise(

# Fig 5E

Fraction of reconstructed juxtaspinal mitochondrial regions with ribosomes detected within 50 nm of the OMM.

**update for 2026 pending** — The source combines regions with ribosomes beyond 50 nm and regions without ribosomes.

**Source data**  
`Fig 5D, E.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX
- `Mito` — Mitochondrial reconstruction ID
- `n_ribosomes` — Estimated ribosome count within 50 nm of the outer mitochondrial membrane

## Data

A positive ribosome count indicates at least one ribosome within 50 nm.

```{r fig-5e-data}
Density <- read_csv("./Fig 5D, E.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% c("Control", "TTX")) %>%
  mutate(Condition=factor(Condition, levels=c("Control", "TTX")),
         Date=as.character(Date), n_ribosomes=as.numeric(n_ribosomes))
if (any(!is.finite(Density$n_ribosomes)) || any(Density$n_ribosomes < 0))
  stop("Ribosome counts must be finite and nonnegative; missing values are not zero.")
Density <- Density %>% mutate(Category=if_else(n_ribosomes > 0,
  "Within 50 nm of OMM", "No proximal ribosomes detected"))
Density
```

## Summary

```{r fig-5e-summary}
summary_table <- Density %>% count(Condition, Category, name="n_Regions") %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>% mutate(total_regions=sum(n_Regions),
                                Percent=100*n_Regions/total_regions) %>% ungroup()
summary_table
```

## Statistics

Two-sided Fisher exact test on condition by presence of proximal ribosomes.

```{r fig-5e-statistics}
fisher_table <- table(Density$Condition, Density$Category)
fisher_table
fisher_result <- fisher.test(fisher_table)
pval <- fisher_result$p.value
stats_table <- tibble(Test="Two-sided Fisher exact test",
  Comparison="Proximal ribosomes present vs not detected, Control vs TTX",
  Odds_ratio=unname(fisher_result$estimate),
  CI_low=fisher_result$conf.int[1], CI_high=fisher_result$conf.int[2],
  p_value=pval)
stats_table
```

## Plot

```{r fig-5e-plot, fig.width=30, fig.height=20}
set.seed(20261109)
fig5e_plot <- ggplot(summary_table, aes(x=1,y=n_Regions,fill=Category)) +
  geom_col(width=1,color="white",linewidth=1) +
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(round(Percent,1),"%")),
            position=position_stack(vjust=0.5),size=20) +
  coord_polar(theta="y") +
  facet_wrap(~Condition, labeller=as_labeller(c(Control="control",TTX="homeostatic plasticity"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Within 50 nm of OMM"="#B33A78",
                             "No proximal ribosomes detected"="#BDBDBD")) +
  labs(caption=paste0("Fisher exact test: p = ",format.pval(pval,digits=4))) +
  theme_void() + theme(plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",color=NA), strip.text=element_text(size=60),legend.text=element_text(size=35),
                      legend.title=element_blank(),legend.position="bottom",
                      plot.caption=element_text(size=35))
fig5e_plot
```

```{r fig-5e-save, include=FALSE}
dir.create("./Graphs",recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
ggsave("./Graphs/Fig 5E.png",fig5e_plot,width=30,height=20,units="in",dpi=300)
```
